youtube_transcript: In this episode, Izuku faces the UA entrance exam and struggles to score points. Despite his training with All Might, he is unable to control his quirk and ends up with zero points. Ochaco, the girl he saved, asks the judges to give her points to Izuku, recognizing his heroic actions. It is revealed that the exam also includes Rescue Points, which are awarded for heroic acts, and Izuku receives 60 Rescue Points for saving Ochaco, allowing him to pass the exam. All Might reveals that he will be working at UA High as a faculty member. The episode ends with Izuku enrolling in UA High, finally fulfilling his dream of becoming a hero. Ochaco receives rescue points for her actions in the exam as well, passing the exam herself.
plot_points: Izuku struggles in the UA entrance exam, failing to score any points.
Ochaco asks the judges to give her points to Izuku, recognizing his heroic actions.
The exam is revealed to have Rescue Points, which Izuku earns for saving Ochaco.
Izuku passes the exam and is accepted into UA High, fulfilling his dream.
All Might reveals he will be working at UA High as a faculty member.
Ochaco receives rescue points for her actions in the exam as well, passing the exam herself
